messages:
lina_csm: Quick heads-up: OrionEdge tokens down ~58% since our champion Priya left last Thursday. Procurement kicked off a short evaluation with QuickServe. marking as renewal-risk and opening triage :warning:
omar_sales: yikes. do we have active seats + who is the replacement contact?
sys_bot: Usage summary: https://console.redwood.ai/accounts/orionedge/usage (14d: -58% tokens, seats 9->4) :bar_chart:
anya_cs: I'll own outreach. propose 20m enablement + a short runbook to restore automated jobs. can we get their top 3 prompts and confirm SSO status? :mag:
sam_eng: No infra errors, but auth logs show a small spike in 403s around the time Priya left. running quick query to confirm:
sam_eng: ```sql
SELECT day, auth_failures FROM auth_summary WHERE account='orionedge' AND day >= '2026-03-01' LIMIT 7;
```
olmar_sales: we haven't offered concessions yet. i'll ok a $2k promo credit if they commit to the enablement + exec sync. legal prefers credits.
lina_csm: plan: (1) anya email + 24-48h calendar propose, (2) ask for prompt samples + run diag, (3) offer the $2k credit on verbal. Anya, can you send the diag snippet?
anya_cs: sure — asking them to run:
anya_cs: ```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/accounts/orionedge/diagnostic -d '{"sample_days":7}'
```
sys_bot: QBR slot available Thu 15:00-15:30 via /calendar book. tickler set for 48h follow-up. :calendar:
lina_csm: assigning owners: anya_cs outreach, sam_eng logs + pre-read, omar_sales commercial. target: enablement + exec sync this week, then re-evaluate renewal risk. :rocket:
